# Egress allow-list for the code monkey bot's agent job.
#
# The author job of lfreleng-actions/github-code-monkey-bot runs a
# coding agent on issue text with every tool allowed. This list is
# what that one job may reach under 'egress-policy: block'. The bot's
# other jobs keep the organisation list
# (../lfreleng-actions/allow_list.txt).
#
# The list is short on purpose. Each entry is a host an agent session
# needs to install a target repository's toolchain, run its hooks and
# tests, or reach the model. A host that only publishes (a package
# upload endpoint, a container registry) or only collects analytics
# has no place here: a session steered by hostile text can send data
# to any host it may reach.
#
# Evidence: harden-runner audit records of 1070 agent sessions across
# 146 repositories, 6 October to 15 November 2026. 988 of them (92%)
# reached nothing outside this list, once aislop's telemetry host is
# set aside. Each comment names the process observed reaching the host.
#
# Absent on purpose:
#   - eu.i.posthog.com: aislop's telemetry, reached by 891 sessions.
#     Run aislop with AISLOP_NO_TELEMETRY=1 instead of allowing it.
#   - Container registries, distribution package mirrors and project
#     servers (Docker Hub, ghcr.io, apt and dnf mirrors, Gerrit):
#     reached by 82 sessions in 23 repositories that build images or
#     test against live services. Give such a repository its own
#     supplemental list; do not widen this one.
#
# Load it by explicit path with harden-runner-block-action:
#
#   - uses: lfreleng-actions/harden-runner-block-action@<sha>  # <version>
#     with:
#       config: 'lfreleng-actions//.github/harden-runner/bots/code_monkey.txt@<.github commit sha>'
#
# This file is not named 'allow_list.txt' on purpose; see
# ../README.md for why a second file of that name breaks forks.
#
# Format: one host[:port] entry per line, sorted alphabetically
# (LC_ALL=C), with a '# comment' directly above each entry.

# GitHub hosted-runner control plane (hosted-compute orchestrator and
# watchdog), reached by the runner itself after the job's steps.
*.githubapp.com:443

# Copilot model API and the CLI's telemetry. The host differs by
# credential: api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com and
# telemetry.enterprise.githubcopilot.com for a personal token,
# api.githubcopilot.com for the job's own token.
*.githubcopilot.com:443

# GitHub user content: raw files and release assets fetched by setup
# actions, prek hooks, uv and node.
*.githubusercontent.com:443

# GitHub REST API: the Copilot CLI itself, and read-only lookups by
# a session's own tools (curl, python).
api.github.com:443

# Copilot CLI metrics endpoint.
cafe.github.com:443

# Google download server: Go toolchain archives fetched by prek for
# 'golang' hooks.
dl.google.com:443

# GitHub documentation, fetched by the Copilot CLI.
docs.github.com:443

# zizmor documentation, fetched by the Copilot CLI.
docs.zizmor.sh:443

# Python package files (PyPI CDN): uv and pip installs for hooks,
# tests and the job's own toolchain.
files.pythonhosted.org:443

# GitHub blog and changelog, fetched by the Copilot CLI.
github.blog:443

# GitHub over HTTPS: checkouts, hook repositories cloned by prek,
# and release downloads.
github.com:443

# Go project site: the release index prek reads before it downloads
# a Go toolchain.
go.dev:443

# Node.js distribution downloads, reached by node-based tooling in
# sessions.
nodejs.org:443

# Go module proxy: 'go' builds and tests, and Go-based hooks.
proxy.golang.org:443

# Python Package Index: uv and pip installs for hooks, tests and the
# job's own toolchain.
pypi.org:443

# npm registry: the job installs the Copilot CLI and aislop from its
# lockfile, and node-based hooks install their packages.
registry.npmjs.org:443

# Astral uv and Python build downloads: the job's setup-uv step and
# uv inside sessions.
releases.astral.sh:443

# Google Cloud Storage: downloads by the 'go' command. A general
# storage host, kept because Go modules do not install without it.
storage.googleapis.com:443

# Go checksum database, consulted by 'go' for every module download.
sum.golang.org:443
